run_collect_scenes: run the script to collect all CLEVR scene JSON files from a directory into a single combined JSON file
run_collect_scenes_with_options: run the script with custom input_dir, output_file, version, date, and license arguments to collect scenes
run_collect_scenes_default: run the script with default arguments to collect scenes from output/scenes into output/CLEVR_misc_scenes.json
review_main_function: review the main function that loads JSON scene files, validates split consistency, sorts by image_index, and writes combined output
refactor_main_function: refactor the main function to support scenes from multiple splits instead of asserting a single split
